title.en: Add, subtract, multiply and divide real functions
Find the domain of the result

say.en: Cost depends on the number of items and so does revenue. Profit is revenue minus cost: a new function made from two others. In this lesson: Add, subtract, multiply and divide real functions.
Find the domain of the result.

body.en: For $f, g : X \to R$: $(f + g)(x) = f(x) + g(x)$, $(f - g)(x) = f(x) - g(x)$, $(fg)(x) = f(x)g(x)$, $(\alpha f)(x) = \alpha f(x)$ and $(f/g)(x) = f(x)/g(x)$ provided $g(x) \ne 0$. The new function is defined where both $f$ and $g$ are.
body.kn: ಫಲನಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಂದುವಾರು ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಗುಣಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಭಾಗಾಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ g(x) = 0 ಆಗುವ ಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡಬೇಕು.

narration.en: Take f(x) = x + 1 and g(x) = x squared.

say.en: Take f(x) = x + 1 and g(x) = x squared.
Add, multiply and divide them point by point.
At x = 2: f is 3 and g is 4, so f + g is 7 and fg is 12.
On the graph, the yellow curve f + g is the white line plus the green parabola.
Take fx equals x plus 1 and gx equals x squared.

problem.en: f(x) = x² and g(x) = 2x + 1. Find (f + g)(x), (f − g)(x), (fg)(x) and (f/g)(x).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. f(x) = x² and g(x) = 2x + 1. Find (f + g)(x), (f − g)(x), (fg)(x) and (f/g)(x).

say.en: Let us solve this together. fx equals x squared and gx equals 2x plus 1. Find f plus gx, (f - g)x, fgx and (f over g)x.
f plus gx equals x squared plus 2x plus 1 equals x plus 1 squared; (f - g)x equals x squared minus 2x minus 1.
fgx equals x squared2x plus 1 equals 2x cubed plus x squared.
(f over g)x equals x squared/2x plus 1, for x is not equal to minus 1 over 2.
So the answer is x plus 1 squared, x squared minus 2x minus 1, 2x cubed plus x squared, x squared/2x plus 1 with x is not equal to minus 1 over 2.

problem.en: f(x) = √x and g(x) = x. Find (f/g)(x) and its domain.

steps.en: f is defined for x ≥ 0 and g for all real x.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. f(x) = √x and g(x) = x. Find (f/g)(x) and its domain.

say.en: Let us solve this together. fx equals the square root of x and gx equals x. Find (f over g)x and its domain.
f is defined for x is greater than or equal to 0 and g for all real x.
(f over g)x equals the square root of x divided by x equals 1/ the square root of x needs x is not equal to 0.
Domain: x is greater than 0.
So the answer is (f over g)x equals 1/ the square root of x, domain (0, infinity).

homework.en: f(x) = x + 1, g(x) = 2x − 3. Find (f + g)(x), (fg)(x) and (f/g)(x).

narration.en: Recap. (f ± g)(x) = f(x) ± g(x); (fg)(x) = f(x)·g(x). (f/g)(x) = f(x)/g(x) only where g(x) ≠ 0. The result lives on the common domain of f and g.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. (f ± g)(x) = f(x) ± g(x); (fg)(x) = f(x)·g(x). g(x) ≠ 0 ಆಗಿರುವಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ (f/g)(x) = f(x)/g(x). ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದ ಪ್ರದೇಶ f ಮತ್ತು g ಗಳ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಪ್ರದೇಶ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. f plus or minus gx equals fx plus or minus gx; fgx equals fx gx.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. f plus or minus gx equals fx plus or minus gx; fgx equals fx gx.

say.en: (f over g)x equals fx/gx only where gx is not equal to 0.
say.kn: gx is not equal to 0 ಆಗಿರುವಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ (f over g)x equals fx/gx.

say.en: The result lives on the common domain of f and g.
